The '''Lorradians''' were the inhabitants of the [[Ecumenopolis/Legends|urban world]] [[Lorrad]]. Many of them lived in terrible conditions while their [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] was [[Slavery/Legends|enslaved]] by the [[Planet/Legends|world]] [[Barseg]].<ref name="Xim">{{SW|url=news/essential-atlas-extra-the-history-of-xim-and-the-tion-cluster|text=Essential Atlas Extra: The History of Xim and the Tion Cluster|int=Xim Week: The History of Xim and the Tion Cluster}}</ref>
